variable.name: Database1ConnStr
variable.description: Connection string for the primary database

variable.name: GITHUB_API_URL
variable.description: Base URL for the GitHub API

sql.description: Create GitHub billing usage table if it does not exist

flow.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[github_billing_usage]') AND type in (N'U')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.github_billing_usage ( billing_usage_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, user_account NVARCHAR(100) NULL, usage_date DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL, product VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, sku VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, quantity DECIMAL(25, 9) NOT NULL, unit_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, price_per_unit DECIMAL(18, 6) NOT NULL, gross_amount DECIMAL(18, 9) NOT NULL, discount_amount DECIMAL(18, 9) NOT NULL, net_amount DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, repository_name NVARCHAR(255) NULL, created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME() ); END

script.description: Fetch GitHub billing JSON via Go script and output JSON payload

flow.sql: INSERT INTO dbo.github_billing_usage ( user_account, usage_date, product, sku, quantity, unit_type, price_per_unit, gross_amount, discount_amount, net_amount, repository_name ) SELECT '{{GITHUB_USER}}' AS user_account, [date], [product], [sku], [quantity], [unitType], [pricePerUnit], [grossAmount], [discountAmount], [netAmount], NULLIF([repositoryName], '') AS repository_name FROM OPENJSON('{{GITHUB_BILLING_JSON}}', '$.usageItems') WITH ( [date] DATETIMEOFFSET '$.date', [product] VARCHAR(100) '$.product', [sku] VARCHAR(150) '$.sku', [quantity] DECIMAL(25, 9) '$.quantity', [unitType] VARCHAR(50) '$.unitType', [pricePerUnit] DECIMAL(18, 6) '$.pricePerUnit', [grossAmount] DECIMAL(18, 9) '$.grossAmount', [discountAmount] DECIMAL(18, 9) '$.discountAmount', [netAmount] DECIMAL(18, 4) '$.netAmount', [repositoryName] NVARCHAR(255) '$.repositoryName' ); SELECT @@ROWCOUNT;
